result.topic_en: Pencil calculations with determinant-like boundary conditions in which coefficients A, B multiply cosines and sines of $\sqrt{1-\beta}\,a$ and $\sqrt{-1-\beta}\,a$, apparently from an eigenvalue/boundary-value problem; the page also contains integral-type expressions with denominators $\alpha^2\pm1+\beta$.

methods.what: Boundary conditions for a combination of two cosine modes giving a linear system in A, B (determinant condition)
Eigenfunction built from the boundary conditions, separated in x and y
Determining coefficients A, B from given function values and derivative (expansion of f)
Algebraic identity splitting a fraction with denominator $\alpha^2-\lambda^2$
